text:
maggie: Quick sync — Q2 DX roadmap triage. Priorities: SDK ergonomics (python + ts), interactive tutorial/playground, reproducible sample infra, migration docs for Dedicated/Private customers. Need to rank by impact/time and customer asks. Who can do estimates? :wave:
ben: I can do numbers for SDK work. Suggest breaking into small PRs: typing improvements, clearer error messages, streaming helper function. Rough ETA: 3 sprints for core items assuming 2 devs.
alice: Interactive tutorial idea: browser-based, editable prompts + replay, tied to a simple cost estimator. MVP = single-page guided flow + record/play + telemetry. Est 4 weeks with 1 eng + 0.5 PM.
charu: Sample infra: one repo with terraform + docker-compose + CI to demo self-hosted Redwood Private. Customers often ask for "deployable example". We can lean on existing infra modules. Est 3 weeks to make a polished example.
sam: Migration docs: checklist + small scripts to migrate API keys, pin model versions, and validate outputs post-migrate. I already have a draft checklist. Also propose an eval harness to compare outputs between model variants.
maggie: Mapping to OKRs: O1 reduce time-to-first-call from signup -> running sample to <10min. O2 cut SDK-related support tickets by 30%. Which initiatives map to which OKR?
ben: SDK ergonomics -> primarily O2. Interactive tutorial -> O1. Sample infra -> O1 + enterprise enablement. Migration docs -> reduces friction for Dedicated/Private migrations (supports both).
charu: Proposed backlog order (fast wins first): 1) small SDK fixes and typing improvements (2w), 2) migration checklist + scripts (1w), 3) interactive tutorial MVP (4w), 4) sample infra repo polish + CI (3w).
alice: For the tutorial we need clear acceptance criteria: 1) 80% of test users complete the flow in <8min during usability test, 2) emit telemetry event `tutorial_completed`, 3) cost estimator displays token estimate within ±20%.
sam: For migration scripts include smoke deploy test to sandbox and a golden-output comparison step. I'll add a minimal test matrix and attach later.
devbot: Reminder: Q2 planning doc is due Friday. Please add story estimates to the planning board: https://board.internal/redwood/dx-q2
maggie: Thanks — @ben @alice @charu @sam please add story points by EOD tomorrow. We'll review in roadmap sync Wed 10:00am. :calendar:
